userStories.title: W2·S1a — Tier config v1 (Basic/Pro/Business) + plan default rename & backfill
userStories.description: Q1 ANSWERED (docs/PRDS/PRD-222-Q1-TIER-STRAWMAN.md is APPROVED v1 — seeded on this branch; it is the numbers contract). (1) config.py: a PLAN_TIERS structure (env-overridable JSON or structured constants — follow config.py's existing style) carrying, per tier basic/pro/business: display_name, display_price_usd (19/49/99 — DISPLAY ONLY, label as early-access; no billing code anywhere, Q5), seats, max_agents (0=unlimited), mission_concurrency, watcher_limit, marketplace_depth, and the capability families (codegraph, nl2sql, team, voice booleans per the strawman table). 'enterprise' appears ONLY as a coming_soon display entry — no limits, not assignable. (2) THE ONE migration: workspaces.plan server default 'starter' → 'basic' + backfill existing rows ('starter'→'basic'); idempotent; nothing else. (3) plan assignment helper (service layer, reused by US-025's tool path): setting a plan writes the tier's limits into plan_limits (seats/max_agents/budget…) as a NEW dict (PRD-220 rebuild-don't-mutate) so existing plan_limits consumers (budget at config.py:794, max_agents) keep working unchanged. NO enforcement hardening beyond what exists — exposure is US-024, quotas stay as-is.

userStories.title: W2·S1b — Exposure profiles: nav + tool-surface + marketplace depth from the tier
userStories.description: Hidden ≠ deleted (D5): trimming is presentation + tool-surface, never data. (1) Server: GET /api/workspaces/current gains an `exposure` block derived from PLAN_TIERS for the workspace's plan (nav item keys, tool families, marketplace_depth, plus the tier display info for UI). Follow US-002's serialization pattern in api/workspaces.py; route manifest untouched (same route). (2) Frontend nav: FIND the real nav/sidebar component (grep for the app's nav item definitions — e.g. command-center/agents/missions link array; it was NOT pinned at kit time); render items gated by exposure.nav — basic hides codegraph/nl2sql/team surfaces per the strawman; a hidden item is absent from nav, its route still resolves (deep links work — no route deletion). (3) Auto's per-turn tool surface: find the single assembly point where platform tool schemas are gathered for a turn (modules/tools/discovery — the registration/listing seam) and filter by the tier's tool families for the workspace; MEASURE per-turn schema tokens before/after for a basic workspace and record the numbers in the commit body (the ~11k-token tool-surface load is a standing complaint — this is the first real trim). Families must be a config-side mapping (tool name → family), not hardcoded in the filter. (4) Marketplace: full catalog stays VISIBLE for all tiers; items beyond the workspace's depth get a plan label chip ('Pro' / 'Business') in marketplace-grid.tsx — no install blocking in this story beyond what exists. All of it config-driven: changing a tier's exposure in config/env changes behavior without redeploy (test proves a config override flips a nav key).
